summary: On the Main Deck, sentinels are everywhere, destroying the ship. Trinity calls out "Neo!", apparently trying to reach or warn him amid the assault.

what_changes.after: Crying out for Neo as the sentinels destroy the ship
what_changes.evidence: sentinels are everywhere destroying the ship. TRINITY Neo!

event_hint.one_line: Sentinels overrun the Nebuchadnezzar's Main Deck while Trinity calls for Neo.

uncertain: Whether Neo is physically present on the Main Deck or whether Trinity is calling to him elsewhere.
The outcome of the sentinel attack, since the scene cuts off on Trinity's call.
